[Overview]{.eyebrow .kicker}

## What it does

Storywell reads the books you've **finished** from a _source_ — Audible, a Goodreads export,
your Kobo, and others — and marks them **read** on [The StoryGraph](https://app.thestorygraph.com),
which has no public import API. It matches each book to the right StoryGraph entry (by ISBN when a
source provides one, by title and author otherwise), writes the finish date, and optionally carries
over your rating and review. Re-runs are idempotent: a book is only re-written if its finish date
changed.

[Origin]{.eyebrow .kicker}

## Why it exists

The previous community tool,
[`good_audible_story_sync`](https://github.com/cheshire137/good-audible-story-sync), stopped working
when StoryGraph put up a Cloudflare bot challenge its Mechanize scraper couldn't solve. Storywell
replaces it with a Python CLI that drives a real Chromium session via Playwright on the StoryGraph
side — sidestepping Cloudflare entirely — and a pluggable source layer on the other.

[One shelf, many sources]{.eyebrow .kicker}

## Sources

One `--source` flag, one matching-and-writing engine behind it. Audiobook sources mark the
**audiobook edition** on StoryGraph; the rest tag the best-matching edition.

::: {.sources-grid}
::: {.source-card}
### Audible <span class="fmt">audio</span>
Reads your finished audiobooks through the maintained `audible` library. The default source.
:::
::: {.source-card}
### Goodreads <span class="fmt">mixed</span>
Reads a `goodreads_library_export.csv`. ISBN-rich, so matching resolves by identifier.
:::
::: {.source-card}
### Kobo <span class="fmt">ebook</span>
Reads finished books straight from an on-device `KoboReader.sqlite`.
:::
::: {.source-card}
### LibraryThing <span class="fmt">mixed</span> <span class="experimental">experimental</span>
Reads a CSV/JSON export. A catalogue, not a tracker — you choose what counts as read.
:::
::: {.source-card}
### Hardcover <span class="fmt">mixed</span> <span class="experimental">experimental</span>
Reads your shelf over GraphQL with a personal API token.
:::
:::

[See the full setup for each source →](sources.qmd)

[Three commands]{.eyebrow .kicker}

## Quickstart

```sh
pipx install storywell
pipx inject storywell playwright && playwright install chromium

storywell storygraph-login          # log in to StoryGraph once
storywell sync --dry-run            # preview the match plan
storywell sync                      # mark finished books as read
```

[Full install & usage →](install.qmd)

::: {.band}
### Still early, and honest about it

Audible → StoryGraph sync is solid. Goodreads and Kobo are validated against real exports.
LibraryThing and Hardcover are **experimental** — read the
[caveats](sources.qmd#experimental-sources) before you trust a run. See where it's headed on the
[roadmap](roadmap.qmd).
:::
